content.title: ‘Age of Attraction’ Reunion: Why Libby Hasn’t Met Andrew’s Kids
content.text: The father of teenage girls reveals what he’s waiting for after the Netflix show.Apr 1, 2026 8:55 PM EDTLibby Vodicka and Andrew Wheeler on ‘Age of Attraction’ NetflixKey PointsAndrew and Libby are managing a long-distance relationship after meeting on Age of Attraction.Andrew won't introduce Libby to his daughters until they're sure of commitment.Libby worries about family judgments due to their televised relationship and age difference. Andrew Wheeler met Libby Vodicka on Age of Attraction. He knew she was younger when she didn’t know who the Spice Girls were, but didn’t find out she was 22 until they committed to each other. The couple decided to try to make their relationship work after the Netflix series. The cast had their reunion and gave an update on their lives a year later. Andrew, 39, explained why he’s waiting to introduce Libby to his daughters. Andrew and Libby of Age of Attraction Want to Live Together First Libby Vodicka and Andrew Wheeler on ‘Age of Attraction’Netflix Andrew has teenage daughters and is open to having more children. He said at The Viall Files reunion that he doesn’t want to have another kid at 46, and that gives the couple a timeline. Libby said she loves that Andrew is a father and is aware of his timeline for a new baby. He hasn’t introduced her to his kids. “We’re trying to figure out the long-distance thing first,” the father said. Libby is in San Deigo and he is in Baltimore. Andrew refuses to introduce a partner to his daughters if he doesn’t know she is his “forever person” after making that mistake once. “I want to see that we can move in together, the relationship is headed to us getting engaged, spending the rest of our life together before we make that introduction,” he explained. Related: ‘Age of Attraction’: Pfeiffer and Derrick: Where Are They Now? His daughters do know he’s dating Libby. Libby addressed the fact that how they met is on a show for them to watch. “There’s an element of judgment that is going to be made one way or another,” she said. “So for me that’s the only hard part is I don’t want anybody in his family to see a little clip of me and make any assumptions versus me in real life.” Libby also hasn’t met the mother of his children. Andrew said it’s up to his ex to ask if she wants to meet his girlfriend. The couple is taking their time before considering getting engaged. They claimed their communication is strong, and they visited each other while keeping their relationship a secret to avoid spoilers.
